summary: Still risk-off into the last 40 minutes: S&P about -0.5% and Nasdaq about -1% with the 10-year near 5% after hot October CPI, Nvidia the main drag. Changes: same six names, but Microsoft bounced to about 535 so its put was tightened and cut, Broadcom reached 330 so its levels moved up, and the index levels were tightened for the close; quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from 2:22 ET news snapshots.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 6% on day two of the Huang probe and FBI headlines; losing the 166.52 midday low into the close opens the 164.27 52-week low (price 167.90 at 2:22 ET).

picks.name: Broadcom
picks.reason: Up about 3.3% against a red tape, extending Monday's 8.8% rebound as money rotates out of Nvidia; over 332 can squeeze into the close, under 326 fades (price estimated).

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq still about -1% with yields pinned near 5%; staying under 672.50 and breaking 667.50 sets up a weak close (price estimated).

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: S&P bounced to about -0.5% but December hike odds cap rallies; failing at 751 and losing 746.50 resumes the slide into the bell (price estimated from the index).

picks.name: Microsoft
picks.reason: Bounced from about 527 to 534.90 (-1.9%) after the Anthropic Office-tools drop; a failed bounce under 531 retests the lows, over 538.50 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Only about +0.7% after fading from the 539.25 high; reclaiming 516 could lift it with Broadcom, under 507 targets the 500 area (price estimated).
